quotedPost.originalText:
I'm just mind-blown right now🤯

I built my own Claude skill because editing motion graphics takes a lot of time. I was working on some other projects and had to solve this time-consuming task. 

This is my first test run of the skill, after completing the whole workflow and building it into this skill. I fed it my mascot GIF, a fire-spear film clip, and my logo animation.

Zero editing software.

post.originalText:
My custom skill + Claude Opus 5.5 🤯

Gave it a still render, a character sheet, a 10s clip and one lazy prompt: "fun motion graphic, comic book style, 10s"

It read the assets, found the beats, and spat out THIS. KA-POW timing, speech bubbles, SFX, the works. https://t.co/rX4ZgGDQql

sourceMaterials.text: @old_internet_p It can't be shared or made public directly, I will need to make a repository in GitHub, but I'm planning to turn it into web based app.. so soon if all works out. 🤞
